tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Riverview Office Cleaning's services, contact details, hours, service area, and how pricing works. Prices are only quoted after a free on-site walkthrough; the published per-square-foot range is a guide, not a quote.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Answers to common questions (what is included, cost, insurance, contracts, start times). Pass a question to get the closest matches, or nothing to get every FAQ.

question.description: The question or keywords, e.g. "are you insured".

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Whether Riverview regularly serves a city. Walkthroughs can only be booked online for cities in the service area.

tools.name: list_walkthrough_slots
tools.description: Open start times for a free 45-minute on-site walkthrough, in America/New_York time. Times are bookable from 24 hours from now up to 21 days out.

start_date.description: First day to look at, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the earliest bookable day.

days.description: How many days to look across. Defaults to 7.

tools.name: book_walkthrough
tools.description: Books a free on-site walkthrough at a time from list_walkthrough_slots, on behalf of the person you are helping. Confirm the time and every detail with them before calling. The office is emailed, and a confirmation goes to the email given. Status "booked" means it is on the calendar; "requested" means the office will call to confirm; "unavailable" means pick another slot.

slot_start.description: The exact "start" value of a slot from list_walkthrough_slots.

email.description: Contact email; the confirmation is sent here.

city.description: Office city; must be in the service area.

approx_sqft.description: Approximate office size in square feet, if known.

notes.description: Anything the crew should know: cleaning frequency wanted, access, special areas.
